class.name: SnowCornice3D
class.brief_description: Draws the cornices a [SnowCover3D]'s world tier grew on lee crests, with collision.
class.description: The overhanging slabs the wind builds on lee crests. [SnowCover3D]'s world tier grows one per crest cell while the wind blows between the threshold for moving snow and twice it, fastest about 40% above it (Yu et al. 2023), from loose dry snow upwind, at field rates of about 1.6 cm an hour (Hancock et al. 2020); they waste back in thaws and in gales. This node draws those within [member radius] of the camera as a swept profile along each run of crest cells: a slab out from the crest top, as thick as it is long at its root and thinning to a sagging lip, its roots reaching down to the ground through the crest's snow. It rebuilds as the camera moves and as the world tier updates. Under path tracing it is ordinary geometry.

method.name: get_segment_count
method.description: How many pieces of profile the last rebuild swept.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the cornices around the camera now.
